captions.detailed: A compact personal countertop blender featuring a low, rounded-square black plastic base with a grey toggle switch on the front panel. Mounted on top of the base is a cylindrical collar that holds a tall, semi-transparent frosted plastic bottle-style jar. Inside the jar, a small metallic multi-blade assembly is positioned at the bottom. The toggle switch pivots forward and backward, the bottle jar twists onto its base mount, and the internal blades are designed to spin continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact personal blender with a low, rounded rectangular black base and a grey front rocker switch. Add a cylindrical twist-on jar collar holding a tall, semi-transparent bottle-style jar, and place a small rotating blade assembly inside the bottom of the jar.
captions.factory: Construct the blender base by creating a rounded box and subtracting a cylindrical cavity for the jar seat. Model the rocker switch as a small angled box and attach it to the front of the base using a revolute joint. Build the jar collar as a cylinder, then construct the bottle jar using a lofted or tapered cylinder with a hollow interior. Inside the jar, construct a small multi-blade propeller using thin boxes and connect it to the base via a continuous rotational joint.
